operator_review_trigger: Operator review of P2-R1 head a8b20a6c: governance components were built but not bound into the execution path — public authority_ok bypass, REQUIRE_APPROVAL not operational on the normal path, caller-modeled recovery re-evaluation, private engine boundary leaks, no durable CLI job submission; P3 NOT authorized

c01_authority_gate_in_execution_path.defect: execute_step exposed a public authority_ok=True caller bypass; AuthorityProvider was never consulted on the normal execution path
c01_authority_gate_in_execution_path.repair: StepAuthorityGate port + typed StepAuthorityVerdict binding principal/action/resource/scope/requirement; engine evaluates the CURRENT gate inside execute_step; no gate configured fails closed; DENY -> POLICY_DENIED, REQUIRE_APPROVAL -> durable request + WAITING_POLICY; verdict step/principal replay guards; composition root wires PolicyStepAuthorityGate + ApprovalRegistrySink with a registered runtime worker principal; policy engine action matcher honors prefix rules

c02_approval_execution_round_trip.defect: REQUIRE_APPROVAL blocked nothing durable: no request artifact, no verified grant release path
c02_approval_execution_round_trip.repair: exact-bound AuthorityRequest with explicit 24h window; service.release_granted_step verifies the GRANT against the request (action/resource/scope/budget, not expired) before engine release; single-use grant key; laundering rejected at registry write AND re-checked service-side

c03_recovery_authority_reevaluation.defect: recovery re-evaluation was modeled by a caller flag
c03_recovery_authority_reevaluation.repair: resumed execution evaluates the live gate, so policy changes during a crash window change resumed outcomes; committed execution records and terminal steps untouched

c04_canonical_submission.defect: no QcaeApp.job_submit; CLI could not durably submit
c04_canonical_submission.repair: versioned JobSubmission envelope validated canonically before persistence (nothing persists on malformed input); deterministic identity; atomic engine path; thin CLI `job submit` durable across process close

c05_boundary_leaks_removed.defect: QcaeApp used service._engine; RuntimeService.identity inspected engine._workers
c05_boundary_leaks_removed.repair: public engine.registered_worker_types(); service mark_running/require_identity/authority_decide surfaces; TestInterfaceBoundary architecture guard (self-verified)

c06_authority_budget_secrets_integration.defect: cross-layer laws were neither stated nor proven
c06_authority_budget_secrets_integration.repair: authority cannot widen budget (approval_ref-only increases; no engine widening path); action permission does not imply secret permission; constrained grants stay constrained across retries and are visible in the event trail
